data.title: 萝丝·奥利安娜 · 暗夜残月下的剑姬起誓
data.action: 伫立在月华石阶前，一手按在胸口，金发在夜风中披散如锦缎，眼神坚定而饱含深情地注视着阴影中的暗影大人。
data.location: 暗影庭园古代遗迹神殿露台，月光如银河倒泻在清澈的水池中，长剑立于一侧
data.lighting: 满月无暇的银白冷光如聚光灯般笼罩全身，在白金长发与透光衣裙上形成圣洁光晕
data.mood: 高洁剑姬褪去王冠后的纯粹忠诚与圣洁献身精神
data.description: 暗影庭园古代遗迹神殿露台，月光如银河倒泻在清澈的水池中，长剑立于一侧。伫立在月华石阶前，一手按在胸口，金发在夜风中披散如锦缎，眼神坚定而饱含深情地注视着阴影中的暗影大人。 她微微抬眸轻语——“暗影大人……我所做的一切，皆是为了追随您的背影。即便褪去这身战袍，我的身心也永属于您。”
data.promptProse: Kneeling beside a mirror-calm pool on the stone terrace of an ancient Shadow Garden sanctuary ruin with her rapier planted nearby, Rose wears a semi-sheer white one-shoulder chiffon slip fastened by a gold wing clasp. Pressing one hand over her heart in solemn devotion, she gazes steadily into the shadows with unwavering resolve. Pure silver moonlight pours across the weathered stone columns, shimmering water ripples, and the draped sheer folds of her gown.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling beside the moonlit ruin pool with her rapier planted in the stone, Rose wears a sheer white one-shoulder chiffon slip and presses one hand to her chest in solemn devotion. Bright silver moonlight illuminates the ancient pillars and water ripples.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a semi-sheer pure white Grecian one-shoulder chiffon slip nightgown fastened at the right shoulder with an antique gold wing clasp.
